dedupe_keys.name: power system oscillation mode prediction data

description: Power System Oscillation Mode Prediction Data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Weike Mo (South China University of Technology). This paper utilizes modern statistical and machine learning methodology to track oscillation modes in complex power engineering systems. The damping ratio of the electromechanical oscillation mode is formulated as a function of power of the generators and loads as well as bus voltage magnitudes in the entire power system. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
